verdict.rationale: Evidence implies cross-platform reach (Windows/Linux keyboard shortcuts in warp-docs-49, Warp Agent CLI usable on 'built-in Windows and Mac Terminals' and Ghostty in warp-docs-41, and a new settings file for 'portability between devices' in warp-docs-40), but there is no explicit, first-party statement that the full Warp terminal ships with identical features/config on macOS, Linux, and Windows, nor any hands-on report confirming parity across all three. Missing for 10: an explicit cross-platform release/config-sync doc, and independent user confirmation that the same config behaves identically on all three OSes.
